n7a3956bddd.headline: Sensex plummets 1,100 points amid rising COVID-19 cases, concerns on economic recovery
n7a3956bddd.summary: India's equity benchmark Sensex fell 1,100 points in early trade due to a global sell-off driven by concerns over rising COVID-19 cases and economic recovery.
n7a3956bddd.why: Sensex is a key indicator of India's stock market and economic sentiment; sharp declines reflect investor fears about pandemic impact on growth.

impacts.name: Sensex
impacts.why: Market sell-off driven by COVID-19 case rise and economic recovery concerns.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n7a3956bddd.why_moved: The sharp fall in Sensex reflects investor concerns about the economic impact of rising COVID-19 cases and uncertainty over recovery prospects.
